# papertrade-sdk

> Unofficial TypeScript SDK for Papertrade (papertrade.xyz), the fully on-chain 1000x synthetic BTC/ETH perps exchange on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM (chain 999). It provides a read API client, a live wallet stream, EIP-712 intent signing (session keys, open, close, withdraw, PAPER staking), deposit builders and settlement math verified against mainnet.

Install: `npm install papertrade-sdk viem`. API base: https://exchange.papertrade.xyz (no CORS, so browsers need a same-origin proxy). The exchange EIP-712 domain name is the literal string "String".

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk#readme): install, quick start, trading, deposits, API surface
- [Protocol reference](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md): endpoints, schemas, intent ids, verified settlement math, staking, deposits, withdrawals, errors
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents building with or changing the SDK

## Examples

- [market.ts](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk/blob/main/examples/market.ts): live market overview
- [watch-wallet.ts](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk/blob/main/examples/watch-wallet.ts): stream positions with distance to liquidation
- [estimate.ts](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk/blob/main/examples/estimate.ts): what a close pays after impact and fees
- [trade.ts](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk/blob/main/examples/trade.ts): session-key trading, dry run by default
